这是沾了信仰之力，又染了功臣血的墨。
陆昭菱曾经无意得了这么一块墨，因为写出来的字格外凌厉霸气，单是看着就令人折服，上面又有极薄的红雾，她十分诧异，就花了好些时间去查那块古墨的来源。
一查才发现，那是最后一个皇朝里一个性情极端的制墨狂人做的。
这是一种油烟墨，用功臣之血加上烟料制成，再封起来，放置于佛祖前面，供奉九九八十一天。
虽说这种墨肯定还有它独特的制作手段，但功臣血是其中最难得的东西。
这种墨实在稀少，自然也没有传扬开来，世人也不知道。
其实在墨块盛兴的时候，各种制墨手段层出不穷，所制的墨也各不相同，这一种算是其中最罕见的罢了。
陆昭菱没有想到在这里也会看到用献墨写的字，而且还是在圣旨上。
这献墨用来写圣旨，倒真的更能让人感觉圣旨威严。
见陆昭菱只顾看着圣旨，陆明胸腔里怒气积得快爆了。
“我是你爹，你总得听我的！无论如何，你不能嫁给晋王！”
他之前是有一点动心，但现在也想明白了，他得坚定不移站在二皇子和皇上这边，不能偏向晋王！
而且，陆昭菱表现出来这个样子，明显也是个刺头，不好掌控的，真得了什么好处，她肯定也不会想到陆家。
最重要的是，他也不能让陆昭菱攀上大树，完全脱离掌控。
“陆昭云和太子定了婚期？”陆昭菱突然问。
“那你们可以考虑让她退婚，反正我接了圣旨了。”
陆昭菱说了这话就示意青音青灵扶起她。
她要回去睡觉，头疼，头晕，今天太累了。
陆家所有人看着她就这么一走了之，反应各异，但愤怒居多。
“小姐，这圣旨本来该由陆大夫供到小祠堂.”青音见她就这么把圣旨拿回来了，忍不住提醒。
“陆家的小祠堂估计脏得很，没必要，收到箱笼里吧。”陆昭菱随手就把圣旨抛给了她。
圣旨还能这么随意抛过来？万一她接不住可怎么办。
还有，小姐说陆家的小祠堂脏得很又是什么意思啊？
“太上皇驾崩的消息马上传来，皇子要守孝多久？”她想起了陆昭云和二皇子的婚约。
陆昭云对外宣称十七了，那早该大婚了吧？
青音说，“大周朝，皇子守孝一年即可。”
这么说，陆昭云一年内当不上二皇子妃，挺好。
而且，她和晋王至少也有一年时间，一年之后她身子和精神应该恢复了，那会儿再退亲正好。
如此看来，陆昭菱突然觉得，太上皇崩的还挺对时候？
“明天你们回一趟晋王府，问问晋王，是把你们暂借我，还是赠与我，如果是后者，把你们卖身契带来。”

> Chapter 21 To borrow or to give (page 1)
This is ink stained with the power of faith and the blood of heroes.
Lu Zhaoling once obtained such a piece of ink accidentally, because the words written were particularly sharp and domineering, and it was impressive just to look at it. There was also a very thin red mist on it. She was very surprised, so she spent a lot of time to find out the origin of the ancient ink.
After an investigation, I found out that it was made by an ink-making madman with an extreme temperament in the last dynasty.
This is a kind of oil smoke ink, made from the blood of heroes and smoke materials, then sealed, placed in front of the Buddha, and worshiped for ninety-nine and eighty-one days.
Although this kind of ink definitely has its own unique production methods, the blood of heroes is the most rare thing among them.
This kind of ink is really rare, so naturally it has not been spread, and the world does not know about it.
In fact, when the ink block was flourishing, various methods of making ink emerged in endlessly, and the inks produced were also different. This kind of ink is considered the rarest among them.
Lu Zhaoling did not expect to see words written in ink here, and it was still on the imperial edict.
This ink is used to write imperial edicts, which really makes people feel the majesty of the imperial edicts.
Seeing that Lu Zhaoling was only looking at the imperial edict, the anger in Lu Ming's chest was about to explode.
"I am your father, you must listen to me! No matter what, you cannot marry Prince Jin!"
He was a little tempted before, but now he has figured it out. He must stand firmly on the side of the second prince and the emperor, and cannot be biased towards Prince Jin!
Moreover, when Lu Zhaoling acted like this, he was obviously a thorn in his side and difficult to control. If he really got any benefits, she would definitely not think of the Lu family.
The most important thing is that he cannot let Lu Zhaoling climb the tree and completely escape control.
"Have Lu Zhaoyun and the prince set a wedding date?" Lu Zhaoling suddenly asked.
"Then you can consider asking her to break off the engagement. Anyway, I have accepted the imperial edict."
After Lu Zhaoling said this, she motioned to Qingyin Qingling to help her up.
She wanted to go back to bed. She had a headache and dizziness. She was too tired today.
Everyone in the Lu family watched her walk away like this. Their reactions varied, but most of them were angry.
"Miss, this imperial edict was supposed to be delivered to the small ancestral hall by Doctor Lu." Qingyin couldn't help but remind her when she saw that she had just brought the edict back.
"The Lu family's small ancestral hall is probably very dirty. It's not necessary. Just put it in a box." Lu Zhaoling casually threw the imperial edict to her.
Can the imperial edict be thrown around so casually? What if she can't catch it?
Also, what did the young lady mean when she said that the Lu family’s small ancestral hall was very dirty?
"The news of the death of the Supreme Emperor is coming soon. How long will the prince have to observe mourning?" She thought of the engagement between Lu Zhaoyun and the second prince.
Lu Zhaoyun announced to the public that he was seventeen, so he should have gotten married long ago, right?
Qingyin said, "In the Zhou Dynasty, the prince only had to observe filial piety for one year."
In this way, it's good that Lu Zhaoyun won't become the second prince's concubine within a year.
Moreover, she and Prince Jin will have at least a year together. After a year, her body and spirit should have recovered, and it would be a good time to break off the engagement.
From this point of view, Lu Zhaoling suddenly felt that the death of the Supreme Emperor was quite timely?
"Tomorrow you go back to Prince Jin's Mansion and ask Prince Jin whether he will lend you to me temporarily or give you to me. If it is the latter, bring you the deed of sale."
